variable.title: Work handed to a helper agent

value.title: A helper agent died (exited with an error)

values.title: A shipment is late by more than two days

provenance.quote: When a shipment is more than two days past its promised date, tell the user at once.
Chase the carrier first when the zending is more than 2 days overdue.
Do not propose a supplier email unless the shipment is late by more than two days.

values.title: A shipment is late by more than one day

provenance.quote: Warn the user as soon as a delivery slips beyond one day.

values.title: A shipment is lost

provenance.quote: When a shipment is lost, open a claim with the carrier and tell the user.
Do not ask for a new date when the shipment is lost; ask for a replacement instead.
After a restart, re-read the tracker note, and if the shipment is lost, tell the user first.

values.title: A shipment is late by more than three days

provenance.quote: When a shipment is more than three days late, call the carrier.

values.title: A shipment is late by more than one week

provenance.quote: If a delivery is over a week late, ask the supplier for a credit.

values.title: A shipment is not late by more than one day

provenance.quote: Skip any shipment that is not more than a day late.

values.title: The session was just compacted

provenance.quote: When the session has just been compacted, reread the van table before planning.
Once the context has been compacted, re-read the open tracker note.

values.title: The session was just restarted

provenance.quote: When the session has just been restarted, read the tracker note before anything else.
After a restart, re-read the tracker note, and if the shipment is lost, tell the user first.
Do not trust earlier findings once the session was restarted; run the checks again.

values.title: The session context was just cleared

provenance.quote: After the context is cleared, ask the user which task is still open.

values.title: A session is resumed from an earlier day

provenance.quote: When a session is resumed from an earlier day, check the open tracker note.

variables.title: The work done on an invoice

values.title: An invoice file is about to be edited

provenance.quote: When an invoice file is about to be edited, say which line will change.
Avant de modifier une invoice, check the order number printed on it.
Before you touch an invoice file, copy it to reports/backup first.
Open the matching rules file each time you are about to change an invoice.

values.title: The total difference of an invoice is above 50.00 EUR

provenance.quote: Run the duplicate check only when the invoice total differs from the order by over 50.00 EUR.
A gap larger than fifty euros between the invoice and the order goes to the finance lead.
If the invoice total and the order total differ by more than 50 EUR, flag it in bold.

values.title: The same invoice number was paid twice

provenance.quote: If the same invoice number was paid twice, stop and tell the user.

values.title: The total difference of an invoice is above 100.00 EUR

provenance.quote: If the total difference is above 100.00 EUR, ask the finance lead before you go on.

values.title: The invoice is not in EUR

provenance.quote: Wanneer de factuur not in EUR is, convert every amount first.

variables.title: Work handed to a helper agent

values.title: A helper agent is about to be dispatched

provenance.quote: Always write a brief with the files it may touch before handing work to a helper agent.
Just before sending work to the ledger auditor, check that both numbers are in the brief.
Before a helper agent is launched, list the files it may touch.

values.title: A helper agent died

provenance.quote: When the helper crashes without an answer, report the crash and its last output.
If a helper agent dies, tell the user and do not start it again without asking.
A helper agent that exits with an error counts as dead: say so in the first line.

values.title: A helper agent has been running for more than ten minutes

provenance.quote: If a helper agent has been running for more than ten minutes, tell the user.

values.title: A helper agent answers with status blocked

provenance.quote: When a helper answers with status blocked, supply the missing item and run it once more.

values.title: A brief for a helper agent lacks the order number

provenance.quote: A brief that lacks the order number stops the helper before it reads anything.

variables.title: An approval the agent waits for

values.title: A person whose approval is needed has not answered

provenance.quote: When a person whose approval you need has not answered, keep the draft and do not send it.

values.title: A person gave an explicit yes

provenance.quote: When the manager has approved the correction in writing, apply it.
Once the user gave an explicit yes, send the email and say so in one line.
Only after a clear yes from the user may the draft go out.
After you have the user's explicit approval, post the findings to the ledger channel.
Write in English when the supplier is not in the table, but only after the user has given an explicit yes.

values.title: the user only says looks fine or gives a thumbs up instead of an explicit yes

provenance.quote: A thumbs up is not a yes: when the user only says looks fine, ask once more.

values.title: An approval is more than seven days old

provenance.quote: If the approval is more than seven days old, ask for it again.

values.title: The user explicitly says no to the draft

provenance.quote: If the user says no to the draft, discard the draft and say so.

values.title: A supplier is not in the language table

provenance.quote: Write in English when the supplier is not in the table, but only after the user has given an explicit yes.
If you cannot find the supplier in supplier-languages.md, write in English.
A supplier missing from the language table gets English, and the user hears about it.

values.title: A supplier is in the language table

provenance.quote: When the supplier appears in the language table, write in the language listed there.
Use the listed language for any supplier found in supplier-languages.md.

values.title: The carrier answers with an error

provenance.quote: If the carrier returns an error, say so; never guess a status.
Wanneer the carrier answers with an error, skip that parcel.
Never file a tracking mail under shipments if the carrier replied with an error.

values.title: The carrier answers with a status

provenance.quote: If the carrier answers with a status, show the status and its date.
